identity_evidence.historical_fit: Schobert was born in Würzburg, Kingdom of Bavaria, entered the Royal Bavarian Army, commanded Bavarian infantry formations, and remained alive in 1936; the July 1940 NAC portrait is face-visible and period-matching.
identity_evidence.role_fit: Defensible Bavarian army-command identity for the BAY emergency/mountain-command abstraction; his historical branch was infantry rather than a specialist Gebirgstruppe formation, which is recorded as a caveat rather than hidden.
identity_evidence.era_fit: July 1940 source is within the World War II era and shows period German military clothing and decorations; subject was alive at the 1936 scenario start.
identity_evidence.crop_note: Exact source crop only; no resampling, retouching, recolouring, or archive-mark removal. The crop retains swept hair, moustache, collar embroidery, visible decorations, and upper tunic silhouette.

imagegen_edit.finish_constraints: Identity-preserving HOI4 painted edit only; deliberate opaque brush planes and quiet painted background; no generated replacement person, reconstruction, generic face, second person, invented insignia, or photo/sepia/filter finish.
